summary: Iteration 9 - 7-day Deluxe trial without plan selection. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration9.py). Verified: (1) POST /api/signup without plan creates customer with subscription_status='trial', plan='deluxe', trial_start_date=now, trial_end_date=now+7d; (2) GET /auth/me returns plan.key='deluxe' + trial_days_left=7 + customer.subscription_status='trial'; (3) Trial user can POST/PUT/DELETE /items normally; (4) POST /subscription/select-plan {plan:'pro'} returns {ok:true, selected_plan:'pro'} and does NOT end the trial (status still 'trial', effective plan still 'deluxe'); (5) After backdating trial_end_date via motor directly, GET /auth/me activates subscription_status='active' with plan=selected_plan when selected_plan is set; (6) After backdating with no selected_plan, status becomes 'expired' and POST /items returns 402 with 'Prøveperioden din er avsluttet' message while GET still works (200); (7) Platform-owner POST /owner/customers/{id}/extend-trial {days:7} resets trial_end_date to now+7d and subscription_status='trial', with trial_days_left>=6 restored; (8) Regression: GET /plans hides 'free', owner-workspace (admin 000001) remains deluxe and unaffected by sync. Frontend verified E2E on preview URL: Signup page shows no plan selector (confirmed), submit shows welcome dialog 'Velkommen til Utstyrsrommet!' with welcome-start-btn, which navigates to /app. In /app the trial-banner is visible in the header with text 'Deluxe prøveperiode • 7 dager igjen'. Dashboard renders trial-card-early with 'Prøv hele Utstyrsrommet' and 7 days-left message. Clicking banner navigates to /app/abonnement where select-basic/select-pro/select-deluxe buttons are present. Clicking select-pro displays toast 'Du beholder Deluxe-tilgangen ut prøveperioden, pro starter etter at prøveperioden avsluttes' and renders 'Valgt abonnement: Klubb Pro - aktiveres når prøveperioden avsluttes' badge + 'Valgt' chip on Pro card. No console errors beyond expected pre-auth 401.
critical_code_review_comments: _sync_subscription_status is called on every GET /auth/me (and inside require_perm->_is_write_allowed on every write) and does a find_one + conditional update_one. For high-traffic tenants this adds 1-2 extra DB roundtrips per request. Consider caching the computed status for a short TTL or only syncing when trial_end_date is near/past.

require_perm's _is_write_allowed does NOT check is_owner_workspace. It happens to be a non-issue because the owner workspace is seeded with subscription_status != 'trial' (and _sync only expires when status=='trial'), but it's a brittle invariant - if the owner workspace is ever accidentally reseeded as 'trial' it will expire 7 days later and block all writes. Recommend adding an explicit short-circuit: if cust.get('is_owner_workspace'): return True.
TrialBanner day-text uses the pluralization 'dag/dager' only in the trial branch, but the daysLeft<=1 branch always shows 'avsluttes i morgen' even when daysLeft is 0 (last day). Minor UX nit.

TrialDashboardCard thresholds differ slightly from spec: early is used for days>3 (so days 4-7), midterm for days 2-3, urgent for days<=1. Spec said 7-4=early, 3=midterm, 1=urgent. Days 2 falling in midterm vs urgent is a product decision - flagging only.
test_credentials: raymond.d.hansen@gmail.com / Snowboard1! (platform_owner). Trial tenants provisioned on-the-fly via POST /api/signup with example.com emails (note: emailvalidator rejects .local TLD - use example.com).
seed_data_creation: test_iteration9.py creates ~4 TEST_It9_* trial tenants per run. Not auto-cleaned - may want periodic manual cleanup of customers where owner_email LIKE 'TEST_it9_%@example.com'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New testids this iteration: trial-banner (header, clicks→/app/abonnement), trial-card-early/midterm/urgent/expired (Dashboard), trial-cta-early/midterm/urgent/expired, welcome-start-btn (post-signup dialog), signup-club/name/email/password/accept-terms/submit (no plan field), select-basic/pro/deluxe (abonnement). Backend endpoints: POST /subscription/select-plan {plan}, POST /owner/customers/{id}/extend-trial {days}. Signup requires accept_terms=true and email must be a public TLD (example.com works, .local does not). To force a trial to expire in tests, update MongoDB customers.trial_end_date to a past ISO date and GET /auth/me will sync status.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The main-agent's prior curl 402-block failure was most likely due to the agent's own curl env-parsing issue; the backend logic itself is correct and verified via motor+pytest (test_expired_trial_no_selected_plan_blocks_writes_402 asserts status==402 and the Norwegian 'Prøveperioden' message).
